pages.raw_meta: Global Water Resources, Inc. is a water resource management company. We provide water, wastewater, and recycled water utility services. Global Water Resources currently services Pinal, Pima, and Maricopa Counties.
raw_blocks: Global Water Resources, Inc. is a water resource management company. We provide water, wastewater, and recycled water utility services.

Recycled water is what we produce when we treat and purify wastewater. We distribute recycled water throughout the communities we serve in a separate system of pipes. We use recycled water for a variety of outdoor uses.
Total Gallons of Water Recycled

Tomorrow's water future depends on the actions we take today. We must preserve, protect, and restore our limited and increasingly valuable water resources. Focused on this mission, we call our approach “Total Water Management.” Total Water Management protects supplies in areas where water is scarce, making supplies available for additional growth and long-term sustainability.

Total Water Management is a comprehensive approach to smart water management that reduces demand on scarce non-renewable water sources and costly renewable water supplies, in a manner that ensures sustainability and best benefits communities both environmentally and economically.
This approach employs a series of principles and practices that result in real reductions in community water use, while allowing for economic development and other quality of life goals.

pages.raw_meta: We are a water resource management company that owns, operates and manages water, wastewater and recycled water utilities in Arizona.
raw_blocks: Global Water Resources, Inc. is a leading water resource management company that owns and operates 39 systems which provide water, wastewater, and recycled water services. The company’s service areas are located primarily in growth corridors around metropolitan Phoenix and Tucson. Global Water recycles over 1 billion gallons of water annually.

The company has been recognized for its highly effective implementation of Total Water Management (TWM). TWM is an integrated approach to managing the entire water cycle that involves owning and operating water, wastewater, and recycled water utilities within the same geographic area in order to maximize the beneficial use of recycled water. TWM also implements smart water management programs, including advanced and remote metering infrastructure. It enables smart water management programs such as 2 remote metering infrastructure and other advanced technologies, rate designs, and incentives that result in real conservation. TWM helps protect water supplies in water-scarce areas experiencing population growth.

Global Water has received numerous industry awards, including national recognition as a ‘Utility of the Future Today’ for its superior water reuse practices by a national consortium of water and conservation organizations led by the Water Environment Federation (WEF). The company also received Cityworks’ 2022 Excellence in Departmental Practice Award for demonstrating leadership and creativity in applying public asset management strategies to daily operations and long-term planning.
Leveraging advanced technologies to benefit our customers, employees, and the environment.
Appropriately managing the entire water cycle through Total Water Management, protecting our most precious resource.
Providing a safe, yet strong, investment opportunity focused on long term value creation.

raw_blocks: Welcome to the GWR Developer Resources Page. We look forward to working with you on your project!

The Development Services Team works in conjunction with several departments within Global Water to ensure a seamless process for Developers. Our team acts as a point of contact in collaboration with the Construction & Engineering, Legal, and Finance teams to ensure agreements are put in place as requiredand we will coordinate on items such as:
Inquiries regarding service territory and coverage areas
New project kickoff and review
Facilitating agreements and collecting payments prior to final plan approval
Completion of the bill of sale once project is complete and approved by C onstruction & Engineering
Facilitation of meter application, payment, and installation as approved by Construction & Engineering

We always strive to do our best and work as quickly as possible to ensure your project is successful. If you have questions or concerns, please reach out to our team at: developmentservices@gwresources.com

The Meter Applications process begins at the end of the project and must be followed in accordance with our requirements. In order to have meters installed in a timely manner, all steps of the process must be followed, and all requirements must be met. Once the project is complete and the GWR Construction & Engineering team has given final approval, we will accept meter applications and payment.
For questions specific to the applications process, please call 480-319-2482 or email meterapps@gwresources.com

Global Water provides service to portions of 3 counties in the state of Arizona. Areas within Pinal, Pima, and Maricopa County are covered by our service territory. If you are interested in inquiring if your parcel or project is located within the boundaries of the Global Water Service territory, please click here and submit your request to our team. We will research the parcel and let you know if we can serve the parcel with water and/or wastewater service

The property must be located within the service territory covered by our Certificate of Convenience & Necessity (CC&N). The rate tariffs, billing procedures, and terms of service for all Global Water utilities are regulated and approved by the Arizona Corporation Commission. For questions specific to the Service Inquiries process, please email developmentservices@gwresources.com
